_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. - The front door at the SOUTH clubhouse is not opening at this time. This is NOT a fob issue. There is a sensor on the door that it appears is not working. They vendor will be out to look at this as the first call tomorrow morning. - In the SOUTH, the bazaar room and billiard room doors are not currently working. You may enter the building through the rear lobby door. During business hours from 8:30 AM until 4PM you may call the office for access through the main lobby door. - Both pool gates, the library door and the east billiard room door at the NORTH clubhouse remain non-functional at this time. You may enter the building through the bathrooms, main door or west billiard room door. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
